# Navis.js v7.1 Features

## Overview

v7.1 completes the deploy story and improves Lambda cold starts:

- **Docker deploy** — `navis deploy docker` for containerized services
- **Lazy module loading** — Optional/heavy modules load on first access
- **Test & demo polish** — `verify-v4` in test runner, Lambda handler on v5 demo

## Docker Deploy

```bash
navis deploy docker --generate-only
navis deploy docker --build --tag my-api:latest
navis deploy docker --build --push --tag registry.io/my-api:latest
```

**Generated files:**

- `Dockerfile` — Node.js Alpine image
- `.dockerignore` — Excluded paths
- `docker-compose.yml` — Local development
- `DOCKER_DEPLOY.md` — Build and push instructions

## Lambda Cold-Start Optimization

As of v7.1, these modules are **lazy-loaded** on first access (not at `require('navis.js')`):

- Messaging: `SQSMessaging`, `KafkaMessaging`, `NATSMessaging`
- Cache: `RedisCache`
- Real-time: `WebSocketServer`
- GraphQL: full GraphQL stack
- gRPC: `GrpcServer`, `loadProto`, etc.
- Docs: `SwaggerGenerator`, `swagger`

Core modules (`NavisApp`, `Cache`, auth, middleware, etc.) still load eagerly.

```javascript
// Only loads gRPC code when you first use it
const { createGrpcServer } = require('navis.js');
const server = createGrpcServer({ port: 50051 });
```

Implementation: `src/utils/lazy-export.js`

## Verification

```bash
node scripts/verify-v7.1.js
npm test
```
